outputs: citation text for pre-selected cited papers given the context of the citing paper

changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard LED format (Longformer Encoder Decoder). Removed duplicate model entries and ensured consistent capitalization.
Metrics were correctly extracted and normalized. The paper uses ROUGE (including ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L) and BERTScore consistently.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The evaluation used automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore) and human evaluation.

guideline: Readability scores: 5-point scale from 1 (unreadable) to 5 (perfectly readable)
Consistency scores: 5-point scale from 1 (not related) to 5 (conveys same message and detail as original text)

changes_made.explanation: Human evaluation guidelines and criteria were correctly extracted. Three human annotators evaluated 150 instances on readability and consistency using 5-point scales.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on citation text generation as a specialized form of text summarization. It introduces CiteBench benchmark with multiple datasets and evaluates various extractive (LEAD, TextRank, LexRank) and abstractive (LED-based) models. Evaluation includes both automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore) and human evaluation (readability, consistency). The extraction was generally accurate, requiring only minor normalization of model names.
